Specify duration-dependent union dissolution

Source: R/union_dissolution.R
union_dissolution.Rd

Construct or attach an optional dissolution process. One continuous hazard per union is carried by the female partner, using years since the union began, independently of either partner's age. Rates are per partnered woman-year (equivalently union-year), not annual probabilities. Omitting this process retains death-only union endings.

Usage

union_dissolution(rates, group_prop_hazard = NULL)

set_union_dissolution(model, rates, group_prop_hazard = NULL)

Arguments

rates

A nonempty data frame with numeric dur_start, dur_end, and rate. Bands are half-open [dur_start, dur_end) in years. Starts and rates must be finite and nonnegative; ends must exceed starts and may be Inf. Bands cannot overlap within an unordered group pair. Gaps and durations outside support have zero hazard. Sex, age and union-status columns are not supported. Input order, custom columns and provenance are retained. An optional group_pair column selects an unordered pair such as "A:A", "A:B", or "B:B"; "A:B" and "B:A" select the same schedule. Optional union_type supplies both cohab and marriage schedules within each pair stratum; without it the same duration risk applies to either type. Pair names require nonempty colon-free group labels. Pair-stratified tables must cover every unordered pair of possible identities, including future ones. Without population groups, warn and use the first canonical pair alphabetically. Omit group_pair for shared rates. group, group_w and group_h schedule columns are not supported.

group_prop_hazard

Optional named numeric vector of finite nonnegative rate multipliers by unordered group pair, e.g. c("A:B" = 1.2) applies in both directions. Omitted pairs use 1; zero suppresses risk. Reversed duplicate keys are errors. With no population groups, simulation warns and ignores multipliers.

model

A hammel_model object.

Value

union_dissolution() returns an inspectable hammel_union_dissolution process with a tibble of rates; set_union_dissolution() returns an updated model.

Details

Births preserve the pending dissolution date. Exact same-person ties select death, then birth, then dissolution; a tied birth occurs while partnered. Dissolution ends the episode, restores both partners' availability, and reschedules the woman under her unpartnered fertility and existing search rules, retaining birth spacing. Optional age-specific search schedules by previous union are specified through union_formation(). Restarts resample at attained union duration rather than reset duration.

Calendar rates

Optional time_start/time_end select half-open absolute calendar-year bands, including fractional years. Active slices retain the existing strata rules and must cover the requested run. Changes precede same-time events without resetting the union-duration origin. Other arguments remain static.

Examples

# Illustrative rates, not demographic defaults.
rates <- data.frame(dur_start = c(0, 5), dur_end = c(5, Inf),
                    rate = c(0.04, 0.02))
model <- hammel_model() |> set_union_dissolution(rates)
